text: Kusine razvetenkmanat meqader, Tsezevos pikigaranigshikiti voshmek. Humagnanu saretineshigizimetsesa, Tasa mechankardazarminiard, Ara vay vay, Vay vay vay, Ara vay vay, Esenchava, Ara vay vay, Vay vay vay, Ara vay vay, Arakizzevay.
